enum.statLegendNote.人口分母＝戶籍人口（同年 12 月底；不: Population denominator = registered household population (end of December; excludes tourists, commuters and other transient population)
enum.statLegendNote.季初步統計，以年度刑案統計為準: Preliminary quarterly figures; the annual criminal case statistics are authoritative
enum.statLegendNote.毒品案發生地多為查獲地，不等於居民犯罪: Drug-case locations are mostly where the seizure happened, not where offenders live
enum.statLegendNote.斷點：2024 年第 3 季（民國 11: Break: from Q3 2024 quarterly cases jumped to about 7× the previous quarter, cause not identified; compare across 2024 with caution.
enum.statLegendNote.斷點：鄉鎮層 2015–2024 約 5: Break: in 2015–2024 about 55% of cases were recorded only to the county, so the 2025 jump at township level reflects a recording change, not more cases (county level is consistent).
enum.statLegendNote.全國件數 2023 年起連年倍增（1,2: National cases have roughly doubled every year since 2023 (1,268 → 2,340 → 5,427), cause not identified.
enum.statLegendNote.部分期別（2026 年 1–6 月等）只: Partial periods (e.g. Jan–Jun 2026) have case counts only, no rates, and are not comparable with full years.
enum.statLegendNote.0 件自成最淺一級（該區該年無通報事件，: 0 cases forms its own lightest class (no reported incident in that area and year; not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.最淺色含 0 件（該區該年無通報事件，不: The lightest class includes 0 cases (no reported incident in that area and year; not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.最淺色含 0（該區該年無通報事件，不是無: The lightest class includes 0 (no reported incident in that area and year; not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.只涵蓋臺北市 12 區；其他縣市鄉鎮為未: Covers only the 12 districts of Taipei City; other townships are not covered (not zero).
enum.statLegendNote.依清潔隊清運責任區統計，不等於該區居民產: Counted by the cleaning squad's collection area, not the amount generated by residents of the district.
enum.statLegendNote.12 區加總不等於全市清運量：區隊量含巨: The 12-district sum is not the city total: district squads include bulky waste and exclude returned waste, while the city total also counts directly managed squads and other units.
enum.statLegendNote.累計值（月底）；分母為民政局月底門牌總戶: Cumulative values (end of month); the denominator is the Civil Affairs Bureau's end-of-month count of addressed households.
enum.statLegendNote.108 年 5 月起公式與分類改變，拆成: The formula and categories changed in May 2019, so the series is split into "up to Apr 2019" and "from May 2019"; the two cannot be joined for comparison.
enum.statLegendNote.與縣市版「公共污水下水道用戶接管普及率」: Not comparable with the county-level public sewer connection rate: Taipei is about 100% there, but 82.8% (Dec 2024) on the Sewerage Office's addressed-household basis.
enum.statLegendNote.缺 12 個月（例如 102 年 11: 12 months have no monthly report (e.g. Nov 2013, Jun 2016, Sep 2020); they are not filled with the previous month.
enum.statLegendNote.92–95 年只有合計，沒有產業分項。: 2003–2006 have totals only, with no breakdown by industry.
enum.statLegendNote.來源「-」＝該區該產業無工廠，記為 0: A source "-" means no factories of that industry in the district and is recorded as 0 (a true zero).
enum.statLegendNote.產業分項自 96 年 1 月起；「99: The industry breakdown starts in Jan 2007; "99 Unclassifiable" appears only in some periods.
enum.statLegendNote.0 家自成最淺一級（該區當月為 0，不是: 0 factories forms its own lightest class (the district had 0 that month; not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.一張使用執照計 1 件；跨區或無地址的執: Each occupancy permit counts as 1; permits spanning districts or without an address (about 0.64%) are not assigned to any district.
enum.statLegendNote.件數逐張計，95 年起比主計處年表多 6: Counted permit by permit; since 2006 this is 6–21% higher than the DGBAS annual table, which uses a different basis.
enum.statLegendNote.核發使用執照不等於完工入住或新增住宅供給: Issued occupancy permits are not the same as move-ins or new housing supply.
enum.statLegendNote.0 件自成最淺一級（該區當月為 0，不是: 0 permits forms its own lightest class (the district had 0 that month; not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.0 棟自成最淺一級（該區當月為 0，不是: 0 buildings forms its own lightest class (the district had 0 that month; not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.0 戶自成最淺一級（該區當月為 0，不是: 0 households forms its own lightest class (the district had 0 that month; not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.建築面積是建築物投影面積，不是總樓地板面: Building area is the building footprint, not total floor area.
enum.statLegendNote.0 自成最淺一級（該區當月為 0，不是無: 0 forms its own lightest class (the district had 0 that month; not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.未涵蓋（只涵蓋臺北市 12 區；其他縣市: Not covered (only the 12 districts of Taipei City are covered; other townships are not zero)
enum.statLegendNote.未涵蓋或無資料（臺北市以外未涵蓋；臺北市: Not covered or no data (areas outside Taipei City are not covered; Taipei's 12 districts occasionally have gaps; neither is zero)
enum.statLegendNote.出典：衛生福利部統計處 死因統計（dat: Source: Cause of Death Statistics, Department of Statistics, Ministry of Health and Welfare (data.gov.tw 5965); Open Government Data License, Version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.0 為該期無死亡（真值，不是無資料）；斜: 0 means no deaths in that period (a true value, not missing data); hatching marks not applicable or no data.
enum.statLegendNote.粗死亡率未做年齡標準化：高齡人口多的地方: Crude death rates are not age-standardized: places with older populations score higher, which does not mean worse health care.
enum.statLegendNote.小鄉鎮人口少，單年數值波動大，建議看 5: Small townships have few residents, so single-year values swing widely; prefer the 5-year totals.
enum.statLegendNote.死亡率分母為 12 月底戶籍人口（衛福部: The rate denominator is the registered household population at the end of December (the Ministry's published national crude death rate uses mid-year population, so values differ slightly); denominators exist only from 2018, so rates start in 2018.
enum.statLegendNote.死因已統一為 109 年起 42 類；C: Causes are harmonized to the 42 categories used from 2020; COVID-19 exists only from 2020.
enum.statLegendNote.5 年平均＝5 年合計死亡數 ÷ 5 年: 5-year average = 5-year total deaths ÷ sum of 5 years of registered population (person-years) × 100,000; only the 2021–2025 window is available.
enum.statLegendNote.人數在有 0 人的組合中，0 人自成最淺: For death counts with zeros, 0 is its own lightest class (no deaths in that period, not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.最淺色含 0（該期無死亡，不是無資料）。: The lightest color includes 0 (no deaths in that period, not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.不適用（COVID-19 自 109 年: Not applicable (the COVID-19 category exists only from 2020)
enum.statLegendNote.小鄉鎮人口少，單年波動大；本層為 5 年: Small townships swing widely year to year; this layer uses 5-year totals, which are steadier, but very small townships should still be read cautiously and not ranked on this basis.
enum.statLegendNote.出典：文化部 文化幣可用藝文消費點（da: Source: Ministry of Culture, Culture Coin participating arts venues (data.gov.tw 177601, downloaded 2026-10-24); Open Government Data License, Version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.名冊登記人數，依登記或聯絡地址所在行政區: Number of people on the roster, counted by the district of their registered or contact address, not where they perform; names are not included.
enum.statLegendNote.0 人自成最淺一級（名冊在該區無登記，不: 0 people is its own lightest class (no one on the roster in that area; not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.臺中市西區 100 人多為登記於草悟道（: Most of the 100 people in Taichung's West District are registered at Calligraphy Greenway (the address only locates to the place name); it does not mean they live in West District.
enum.statLegendNote.名冊為自願登記，臺中市偏多可能反映制度差: Registration is voluntary; Taichung's high count may reflect differences in local licensing schemes, so do not read this as the actual distribution of street performers.
enum.statLegendNote.點位見「文化」主題的「文化幣藝文消費點」: For points, see Culture Coin Venues under the Culture theme (street performers are not included there).
enum.statLegendNote.出典：財政部國有財產署 國有非公用土地管: Source: National Property Administration, report of state-owned non-public land by management status (data.gov.tw 30583); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.出典：財政部國有財產署 國有非公用房地數: Source: National Property Administration, report of state-owned non-public real estate quantity and value (data.gov.tw 30580); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.出典：財政部國有財產署 歷年國有非公用不: Source: National Property Administration, annual leases of state-owned non-public real estate (data.gov.tw 6720); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.出典：財政部國有財產署 國有非公用住宅用: Source: National Property Administration, state-owned non-public residential land table (data.gov.tw 36963); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.出典：台灣糖業股份有限公司 可供出租土地: Source: Taiwan Sugar Corporation, land available for lease (data.gov.tw 25754); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.出典：台灣糖業股份有限公司 資產公告土地: Source: Taiwan Sugar Corporation, announced land details (data.gov.tw 101669); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.出典：法務部行政執行署 所屬分署已拍定不: Source: Administrative Enforcement Agency, real estate sold at auction by its branches (quarterly files by year, data.gov.tw 178752 and others); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.114 年底存量（單一期）。: Stock at the end of 2025 (single period).
enum.statLegendNote.占比分母為未處理土地面積（13 個管理區: The share's denominator is unprocessed land area (sum of the 13 management statuses).
enum.statLegendNote.最淺色含 0（該區為 0，不是無資料）。: The lightest class includes 0 (the area is 0, not missing).
enum.statLegendNote.0 自成最淺一級（該區為 0，不是無資料: 0 forms its own lightest class (the area is 0, not missing).
enum.statLegendNote.管理區分含「未處理土地」「已處理土地」兩: Management status includes two subtotals (unprocessed and processed land); do not add across statuses. Processed land is no longer in the current stock.
enum.statLegendNote.每平方公尺價值只供縣市間比較，不可乘回面: Value per m² is only for comparing counties; do not multiply it back by area or add it up into a total value of state property (the source does not say whether it is book value or announced current value).
enum.statLegendNote.不適用（該類面積為 0，沒有單位價值）: Not applicable (area of this category is 0, so no unit value)
enum.statLegendNote.分類含「土地」「房屋」兩個小計，不可跨類: Categories include two subtotals (land and buildings); do not add across categories. Building area is floor area of the structures.
enum.statLegendNote.91–99 年臺中、臺南、高雄為改制前縣: For 2002–2010, Taichung, Tainan and Kaohsiung are the combined values of the former county and city; Lienchiang has no data for 2002–2004.
enum.statLegendNote.無資料（連江縣 91–93 年來源為「-: No data (Lienchiang 2002–2004 is "-" in the source, not 0)
enum.statLegendNote.台糖公告「可供出租」的土地清單，不是台糖: Taisugar's published list of land available for lease, not the total land Taisugar holds. Townships not on the list are not covered (hatched), not 0.
enum.statLegendNote.未涵蓋（台糖清單未列此鄉鎮，不是 0）: Not covered (township not on Taisugar's list, not 0)
enum.statLegendNote.歷年標租標的，非持有地（2016 年起至: Past lease tender items, not land held (cumulative announcements from 2016 to the download date). Townships not on the list are not covered (hatched), not 0.
enum.statLegendNote.公告列數未去重（同地號被公告幾次就計幾次: Listings are not deduplicated (a lot announced several times is counted each time); area and lot counts are deduplicated by lot.
enum.statLegendNote.行政執行（欠稅、罰鍰等）拍賣的已拍定件數: Counts of properties sold at administrative enforcement auctions (unpaid taxes, fines, etc.). Not state property, excludes court auctions, and does not represent the local housing market; the source has no amounts.
enum.statLegendNote.2026 年只到 9 月 30 日（部分: 2026 only runs to 30 September (partial year); do not compare with full years.
enum.statLegendNote.某縣市當年有標的未填鄉鎮時，該縣市所有鄉: If any item in a county lacks a township in a year, all its townships are marked no data (hatched) for that year, not 0. Small townships fluctuate widely from year to year.
enum.statLegendNote.無資料（該縣市當年有標的未填鄉鎮，鄉鎮值: No data (some items in this county lack a township this year, so township values are incomplete; not 0)
enum.statLegendNote.出典：財金資訊股份有限公司 金融卡-AT: Source: FISC, financial-card ATMs by county (data.gov.tw 24357); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.加入財金跨行系統的金融卡 ATM 機台數: Number of financial-card ATM machines on the FISC interbank network, not the number of sites; for sites see township ATM Sites.
enum.statLegendNote.每萬人只在有戶籍人口快照的期別計算（各年: Per 10,000 people is computed only for periods with a household-registration population snapshot (each December and August 2026); other months are not extrapolated.
enum.statLegendNote.出典：金融監督管理委員會銀行局 金融服務: Source: Banking Bureau, FSC, list of financially underserved townships (data.gov.tw 119808); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.判定依據：金管會金管銀合字第 11002: Basis: category 1 of "areas needing more financial branches" under FSC Order Jin-Guan-Yin-He-Zi No. 11002745482 (no domestic bank or credit cooperative, and population served per financial institution above the national average); as of 2026-06-30, 48 townships in 14 counties. The category 2 list is not published and is not shown.
enum.statLegendNote.0＝不在名單（不是缺值，也不代表當地金融: 0 = not on the list (not missing, and it does not mean financial services there are sufficient).
enum.statLegendNote.只有名單內 48 鄉鎮有值；屏東獅子鄉、: Only the 48 listed townships have values; Shizi (Pingtung), Wanrong (Hualien) and Jinfeng (Taitung) have 0 institutions of every type (including post offices and farmers' associations).
enum.statLegendNote.不在名單（來源未提供，不是 0）: Not on the list (not provided by the source, not 0)
enum.statLegendNote.出典：中央銀行金融業務檢查處 各縣市金融: Source: Department of Financial Inspection, Central Bank, financial institutions by county (data.gov.tw 13653); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.基準日 115/09/30；總機構與分行: As of 2026-09-30; head offices and branches each count as one unit, other sub-branch units are not counted.
enum.statLegendNote.金門縣、連江縣來源合併為「金馬地區」一列: Kinmen and Lienchiang are merged into one "Kinmen-Matsu" row in the source and are not split, so both counties show no data (hatched).
enum.statLegendNote.無資料（金門、連江來源合併計算未拆分；不: No data (Kinmen and Lienchiang are merged in the source and not split; not 0)
enum.statLegendNote.出典：財金資訊股份有限公司 總分支機構位: Source: FISC, head office and branch locations (data.gov.tw 24323); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.依名冊地址計數（下載日 2026-10-: Counted from roster addresses (downloaded 2026-10-24); only branches of domestic, foreign and mainland-Chinese banks, credit cooperatives, and farmers' and fishermen's association credit departments. For post offices see the Post Offices layer.
enum.statLegendNote.本國銀行比央行統計略多（名冊含營業部、國: Domestic banks are slightly higher than the central bank's count (the roster includes non-branch units such as business and international departments).
enum.statLegendNote.每萬人以戶籍人口（2026 年 8 月）: Per 10,000 people uses the household-registration population (August 2026) as the denominator.
enum.statLegendNote.出典：財金資訊股份有限公司 金融機構 A: Source: FISC, ATM locations and head office/branch locations (data.gov.tw 24333, 24323); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.地址只寫市名或解析不到時，依定位點所在鄉: When an address gives only the city or cannot be parsed, the township is taken from the point's location.
enum.statLegendNote.ATM 為「裝設點」數（同一地點多台算一: ATMs are counted as sites (several machines at one place count once), not machines; downloaded 2026-10-24.
